48.original: Have you a moment or two to ssspare, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? I have an overconfident recruit who could benefit from a sssparring sssession with one of your experience.

49.original: Captain Alpa is expending every effort to sssecure our position here on the bridge, and we cannot afford to have unreliable sssoldiers in our ranksss.

50.original: You will find thisss recruit training with an inssstructor in the Striped Hills─open my sssister's eyes to her shortcomings, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.

51.original: You... You're the eikon-ssslayer! What need do you have of one like me?

53.original: You've come to train our ssstone-headed sssister? Good. She has talent for the ssspear and the blade, but has yet to learn the value of humility.

54.original: If you're ready to ssspar, then let usss be about it!

56.original: But, I thought...<hex:02100103>I need to catch my breath...

58.original: You ssstrike with admirable force, but do not underessstimate your opponent.

59.original: I appreciate the way you humbled her, ssstrider. Watching you fight was as much a joy for me as it was a lessson for her.

60.original: And now that you have knocked her down, it will be my job to build her up again─thisss time with better habitsss I should hope. Eshana will be pleased.

62.original: Hah! You ssspared her no mercy, then! That is good. I only hope that the change to her perssspective lasssts longer than her bruises.

63.original: And if it doesn't, well...I may sssend you for another sssparring match!

64.original: Return to Eshana─I will follow up on the “educational” drubbing you gave my sssister.
